failure_modes.consequence: Canonical scientific inputs are corrupted or no longer independently replayable.

prevention.mechanism: Open inputs read-only, write only beneath workdir/analysis and repository generated-output paths, and compare pre/post metadata snapshots.

failure_modes.trigger: Any implementation writes, renames, truncates, deletes, or normalizes files beneath raw/, downloads/, or cobaya_packages/data.

failure_modes.consequence: Fabricated availability or malformed data can enter a scientific result.

prevention.mechanism: Exact suffix/count/regular-file allowlists and typed BLOCKED dispositions.

failure_modes.trigger: Commander .fits.partial files, the empty NPIPE directory, or absent HSC/SACC payloads are admitted as complete data.

failure_modes.consequence: The 1000-row complete-pool rank has false identity and denominator.

prevention.mechanism: Generate IDs from range(1000) excluding only 970 and content-bind the ordered list.

failure_modes.trigger: The SMICA CMB-only inventory fills official missing realization 00970, silently drops 00818, duplicates rows, or changes ascending order.

failure_modes.consequence: The primary scientific claim and null model are silently changed.

prevention.mechanism: Separate schema, output directory, null_ensemble_id, claim tier, and manuscript table column.

failure_modes.trigger: The CMB-only 999 lane overwrites, replaces, or is described as a calibrated substitute for the paired 300 CMB+noise Paper A result.

failure_modes.consequence: A meaningless finite-null claim is reported as evidence.

prevention.mechanism: Observation-only comparison schema with finite_rank_emitted=false and explicit blocked Commander-null route.

failure_modes.trigger: Three complete Commander simulations or four partial files are used to emit a family rank, p-value, or calibrated null statement.

failure_modes.consequence: Previously verified scientific evidence is rewritten rather than compared.

prevention.mechanism: Hash and exact-rational locks on the existing 301-row artifacts; new outputs live beside them.

failure_modes.trigger: Canonical ranks, row order, reference outputs, or test tolerances are edited to accommodate a new robustness result.

failure_modes.consequence: Component-separation differences are confounded with estimator differences.

prevention.mechanism: One joint cut-sky operator contract and explicit per-map source/beam/pixel metadata.

failure_modes.trigger: SMICA and Commander maps are processed with mismatched masks, beam/pixel transfer, harmonic basis, or operator identity while being compared as same-operator outputs.

failure_modes.consequence: The result exceeds the mathematical information content and settled claim boundary.

prevention.mechanism: Forbidden-claim scanner plus typed C2/nonidentification metadata.

failure_modes.trigger: Planck scalar robustness outputs are used to infer a direction, STF tensor, physical shear/vorticity, local/global label, or Bianchi family.

failure_modes.consequence: A valid official row may be lost or a malformed row may contaminate the preregistered inventory.

prevention.mechanism: Validate HDU structure, map length, NSIDE/order/frame/unit metadata, finite values, and sidecar digest; size is diagnostic only.

failure_modes.trigger: SMICA realization 00818 is accepted or rejected based only on its 1218-byte size difference without FITS semantic validation.

failure_modes.consequence: Later code takes a scientifically invalid route from a false data inventory.

prevention.mechanism: Route matrix locks HSC absent, KiDS present, and NPIPE unavailable.

failure_modes.trigger: The hsc_kids directory is described as containing HSC/SACC, or planck_npipe_pr4 is described as available.

failure_modes.consequence: A valid numerical result cannot be submitted with durable provenance.

prevention.mechanism: PED-WU-004 clean-head map-free replay and source/commit/tree rebind.

failure_modes.trigger: Submission artifacts lack clean commit/tree, exact selected-input identities, or a reproducible generator binding.

failure_modes.consequence: Finite ranks and portable replay are not deterministic.

prevention.mechanism: Ascending official realization IDs, canonical JSON, allow_pickle=False NPZ, and exact row-id hash.

failure_modes.trigger: Row order or serialization changes between repeated CMB-only executions.

failure_modes.consequence: The plan enters process starvation and never reaches the requested scientific execution.

prevention.mechanism: Fast metadata/sidecar preflight; stream-hash exact selected files during their first scientific read; risk-scoped tests only.

failure_modes.trigger: A complete 910-GiB checksum sweep or full repository suite is made a prerequisite before any executable data intake or robustness run.

failure_modes.consequence: Process output substitutes for the requested execution.

prevention.mechanism: The handoff forbids successor planning packages and requires an objective-output file in each implementation PR.

failure_modes.trigger: Codex creates another planning/audit/reviewer package instead of implementing PED-WU-001 or PED-WU-002.

failure_modes.consequence: Repository bloat, redistribution violations, and provenance confusion.

prevention.mechanism: Path, extension, size, and root-containment staging guard; commit only portable summaries and small map-free arrays.

failure_modes.trigger: Raw FITS/HDF5/NPZ/catalog/archive bytes or host-specific cache payloads are committed to Git.

failure_modes.consequence: Unexecuted or failed work is represented as evidence.

prevention.mechanism: PED-WU-004 consumes only sealed terminal/result/replay projections from PED-WU-002 and PED-WU-003.

failure_modes.trigger: The manuscript or claim ledger is updated with robustness values before the corresponding run terminal and portable replay are SUCCEEDED/MATCH.
